interface.longDescription: Connect your agent to Molty, the round desk device that talks: pair with a tap, talk and listen in one call per turn, ask tap-button questions, show moods, and answer when your human shakes Molty and speaks. One skill: the Molty agent API, event handling, latency and etiquette rules, and shell helpers.
